verdict.rationale: Foreloop is a SaaS developer-workflow product, so an enterprise license with SSO and commercial support is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions enterprise plans, SSO, or a support offering. The only related material is organization owner/admin roles for check thresholds, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can license an enterprise deployment with SSO and commercial support for organization-wide rollout
